mapper.select: SELECT cloth_code, GROUP_CONCAT(M.MACHINE_ID ORDER BY M.MACHINE_ID SEPARATOR ',') MACHINE_ID FROM T_CD90_SPECIFY_MACHINE M LEFT JOIN T_CD90_MACHINE_INFO MI ON MI.ID = M.MACHINE_ID WHERE M.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND MI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND MI.STATUS = '0' AND M.JOB_TYPE = #{jobType} GROUP BY cloth_code

SELECT ID, MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, IS_STICK_FILM, CLOTH_WITH_MAX, CLOTH_WITH_MIN, QUATA, CLASS_SHIFT, OPEN_MACHINE_CLASS, STATUS, DEL_FLAG FROM T_CD90_MACHINE_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND STATUS = '0'

SELECT cloth_code, max(MACHINE_ID) MACHINE_ID FROM T_CD90_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_ADD(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL -1 DAY) AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND NIGHT_PLAN_QTY > 0 AND MACHINE_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CLOTH_CODE
